subject.title: [Bug] LINE channel: messages not delivered + Markdown table/code block rendering broken

question: Which active LINE repair path should own this broad issue: the broad formatting/payload PR, the focused Reply API batching PR, the reply-token safeguard PR, or a maintainer-authored narrower replacement?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible but combines multiple LINE behaviors and open PRs with proof/policy blockers, so automation cannot safely choose merge order or proof override policy.

options.title: Review the three active PRs as coordinated slices
options.body: Keep this issue open, decide merge order for the formatting, batching, and retry/keepalive PRs, and require live LINE proof or explicit maintainer proof overrides before closing.

options.title: Sponsor one narrower replacement
options.body: Close or pause the contributor branches only after a maintainer-owned replacement covers the same symptoms with a clear proof plan.

options.title: Split remaining symptoms
options.body: Use the focused issues for Push quota and reply-token loss, then split any leftover rendering or payload-size behavior into narrower reports after the active PRs resolve.

recommendation.title: Review the three active PRs as coordinated slices
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, decide merge order for the formatting, batching, and retry/keepalive PRs, and require live LINE proof or explicit maintainer proof overrides before closing.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the best available routing owner from the history because current blame and original LINE plugin co-authorship both point to the same LINE channel surface.
